meta.description: Ten Web-GUI-facing components: dimmed text, session unread dots, turn labels, sidebar width persistence, 1-minute speed and cost, previous-prompt recall, the Feishu bridge (QR provisioning, binding, private chat, cloud docs, questions and approvals), expanded ask rows, unsent sessions kept in the sidebar, and composer draft attachments (screenshots / images / files) kept across session switches and reloads (the last three are patched host-side). Each row is a separate switch.
